definition: Governed New Jersey municipal planning and mobility fields added only where official source semantics are exact. DCA Fourth Round calculations are non-binding guidance, not legal determinations. Walking-to-work share is a published mobility statistic, not a generalized walkability score.
activation_rule: Catalog inclusion does not imply live coverage. Each marker is shown as live only when production provider coverage is verified.

markers.label: Fourth Round present need
markers.description: NJ DCA published 2025–2035 Fourth Round Present Need calculation for the municipality. Non-binding guidance; not a legal determination.
markers.professional_reason: Compare DCA's published municipal present-need calculation while preserving its non-binding legal status.

markers.label: Fourth Round prospective need
markers.description: NJ DCA published 2025–2035 Fourth Round Prospective Need calculation before the 1,000/20% cap. Non-binding guidance.
markers.professional_reason: Review DCA's published prospective-need calculation without treating it as a binding obligation.

markers.label: Fourth Round capped prospective need
markers.description: NJ DCA published Fourth Round Prospective Need after the 1,000/20% cap calculation. Non-binding guidance.
markers.professional_reason: Use the DCA-published capped calculation as a research input, not a legal conclusion.

markers.label: Qualified Urban Aid municipality
markers.description: NJ DCA Fourth Round table indicator for Qualified Urban Aid Municipality status.
markers.professional_reason: Identify the exact DCA-published Urban Aid input used in Fourth Round calculations.

markers.label: Fourth Round nonresidential value factor
markers.description: NJ DCA published Equalized Nonresidential Valuation Factor used in Fourth Round calculations, percentage points.
markers.professional_reason: Inspect an exact published allocation-factor input instead of inferring development capacity.

markers.label: Fourth Round land capacity factor
markers.description: NJ DCA published Land Capacity Factor used in Fourth Round calculations, percentage points.
markers.professional_reason: Review DCA's published land-capacity allocation factor without converting it into parcel zoning or buildability advice.

markers.label: Fourth Round income capacity factor
markers.description: NJ DCA published Income Capacity Factor used in Fourth Round calculations, percentage points.
markers.professional_reason: Review the exact DCA-published income-capacity allocation factor.

markers.label: Fourth Round average allocation factor
markers.description: NJ DCA published Average Allocation Factor used in Fourth Round calculations, percentage points.
markers.professional_reason: Expose DCA's exact combined allocation factor with source provenance.

markers.label: Fourth Round 1,000/20% cap
markers.description: NJ DCA published municipality-specific 1,000/20% cap value used in the Fourth Round table.
markers.professional_reason: Compare the exact cap input used by DCA without interpreting statutory effect.

markers.label: Walking to work share
markers.description: NJ DCA 2026 Neighborhood Trends published percentage of employed workers age 16 and older walking to work. This is not a generalized walkability score.
markers.professional_reason: Use the exact published commuting statistic rather than an invented walkability score or commute-mode mix.
